construction_policy.gold_selection: minimal query-specific GraphDB evidence with per-entity completeness validation
construction_policy.observation_selection: requested predicate first; current/latest selects one latest record; otherwise temporal evidence, then structural fallback
construction_policy.current_semantics: latest available record in the frozen GraphDB snapshot; not interpreted as wall-clock real-time
construction_policy.derived_answers: forecast/modeling, anomaly, trend, comparison, aggregates, risk, causal claims, alerts/maintenance/connectivity, unverified river topology, distance/network metrics, ecological assessments, management sufficiency, and unmapped query intents are flagged for manual review
